results.scenario: Duplicate department name prevention verification in database
results.steps: 1. Check if multiple department rows share identical uppercase names
results.expected: Each department name must be unique. No duplicate names allowed in DB.
results.actual: FAIL: Multiple duplicate department records detected in database (e.g. ACCOUNTS, HR)
results.remarks: Departments table currently allows inserting duplicate names without UNIQUE (LOWER(name)) constraint
results.suggestedFix: ALTER TABLE departments ADD CONSTRAINT uq_department_name UNIQUE (name);
